row.title: Kitereizen Kite Camp Vietnam with Marc Jacobs, My Hoa Lagoon
row.summary: Dutch kite-travel organiser Kitereizen runs a one-week big-air coaching camp on the My Hoa lagoon near Phan Rang, Vietnam, with King of the Air winner Marc Jacobs coaching through BB-talkin radio headsets, evening video analysis and photos of your jumps; January winds there typically blow 15-40 knots. The 7 nights are spent at a basecamp directly on the lagoon (deluxe room, infinity pool, recovery bath) with full board, Cam Ranh airport transfers, an own scooter and daily laundry; extra clinics, gear rental and a partner place can be added. Weeks 2027: January 1-8 and January 8-15, EUR 1,995 per person in a shared room, EUR 2,395 in a private room.
row.price_basis_note: From EUR 1,995 p.p. (cheapest bookable: Shared deluxe room, 2027-01-01; as of 2026-10-20)

row.title: KiteAdventure Colombia Kite Course + Stay, Mayapo
row.summary: An IKO-certified kite school on the Second Beach of Mayapo in La Guajira, Colombia, sells course-and-stay packages: private lessons with gear and IKO certification, a private room with breakfast at a partner lodge in Mayapo, and the return transfer from Riohacha. Packages: 8 private hours with 3 nights (COP 2,944,000), 10 private hours with 3 nights (COP 3,013,000), 12 private hours with 4 nights (COP 3,438,500), per student, any dates on request. Shallow, warm water in steady trade winds; beginners welcome. Dates are confirmed on WhatsApp, then a 30% card deposit secures the booking.

row.title: KiteGeneration Kite Camp EXperience, Punta Trettu
row.summary: KiteGeneration runs fixed-date group kite camps in Punta Trettu, the shallow flat-water lagoon in south-west Sardinia. A camp is 5 nights at Villa Punta Trettu directly on the spot (private en-suite rooms, pool, garden) with a 15-hour course from first steps to independent riding and all gear, including a personal wetsuit, harness and helmet for the week. Per person: EUR 975-1575 in low season (September to June) and EUR 1075-1775 in July and August, depending on private or semi-private course and single or double room. Camps run from 4 participants; booking is by request. Runs every year on fixed dates; the next dates are not published yet (2026: May, June, July, 23 August - 28 August).

row.title: Kite Sisters Boutique Kitesurf Retreat Brazil

row.title: LakeUnited Snowkitecamp Norway
row.summary: LakeUnited, an Austrian kite school, runs 7-night snowkiting weeks - kiting on snow with skis or a snowboard, not on water - on the Hardangervidda plateau in Norway, based in the school's own cabin in Vøringsfoss near Eidfjord. The group drives up to the plateau every day and kites with supervision, guiding and a GPS tracker rather than classic lessons; skiers or snowboarders who have flown a kite before can join, and the cabin has five double rooms, a sauna and a fireplace. A week costs EUR 1,730 in a double room; meals are cooked together from a group fund (about EUR 150 per person), and travel and gear rental are extra. Weeks 2027: 20 February to 27 February, 27 February to 6 March, 6 March to 13 March, 13 March to 20 March; booking is by non-binding request.

row.title: Pallas Kiteweek, Finnish Lapland
row.summary: Pallas Kiteweek is a week of snowkiting - kiting on snow with skis or a snowboard, not on water - on the fells of Pallastunturi in Finnish Lapland, organised every February by Kiteschool Lappis. Everyone stays together at Lapland Hotels Pallas, a short walk from the launch area, for 7 nights with breakfast, dinner and the hotel's sauna and gear rooms; participants kite on their own, and lessons, mountain guidance and rental gear can be booked as extras. Prices per person run from EUR 840 in a shared room to EUR 1,395 in a single room; shorter stays are priced per night. Next week: 13 February 2027 to 20 February 2027, booked in the Lappis online shop with a EUR 50 deposit per person.

row.title: My Salty Sisters Kite Retreat Rhodes (women only), Kremasti
row.summary: My Salty Sisters runs women-only kite and empowerment retreats; on Rhodes the group stays a week in Kremasti, a village near Rhodes town whose beach has steady side-shore wind, with the Air Riders Kite Pro Center as partner station. The week includes 7 nights in shared rooms of a beachfront accommodation with breakfast, daily guided kite sessions and group coaching, morning body & mind workouts, empowerment workshops, a beach BBQ and a trip to Rhodes town; flights, transfers, lessons and rental gear are extra. All levels are welcome, but riders must be able to go upwind safely (lessons with the partner school at 15% off). Next retreat: 19 June 2027 - 26 June 2027, EUR 1,290 per person (early bird, regular 1,390, last minute 1,450); booking by form.

row.summary: KitesurfMaroc is a kite school in Essaouira, Morocco, that teaches in semi-private lessons and drives its students by 4x4 to the riding spots around the town. Its one-week kite camp includes 6 nights in a riad in the medina (private room with bathroom, Moroccan breakfast), 14 hours of kite lessons over 7 days, all equipment and the 4x4 transport to the spots; surf lessons replace kiting on days without wind. row.title: Oasis Kite - Kitecamp Djerba
row.summary: Oasis Kite, a kite school from Magdeburg, runs Saturday-to-Saturday kite camp weeks on Djerba with seven nights in its two-storey Kite Villa (pool, air-conditioned double rooms, roof terrace, beach 200 m away), seven breakfasts and five dinners, and airport and spot transfers. row.title: Escape Eco Indonesia Kitesurfing Tour 2027
row.summary: Escape Eco Adventures runs a 7-night kitesurf progression week at Batikite Resort in Mallasoro, Jeneponto (South Sulawesi, Indonesia), with the kite spot, a flat and shallow lagoon, right in front of the resort. Seven days of kiting with on- and off-water coaching from qualified instructors, wind and trick theory, drone and on-water video, breakfast, lunch and dinner and a private airport shuttle are included; the trade wind blows mostly 15-25 knots. The 2027 weeks are 2027-06-27 to 2027-07-04 and 2027-07-04 to 2027-07-11; the week suits complete beginners as well as riders working on jumps and rotations. Prices start at AUD 2,850 per person in an air-conditioned twin share (private and premium rooms cost more), with a AUD 1,000 deposit; flights, gear rental and insurance are extra.

row.title: Latitudes Nord Snowkite Touring Weeks, Finse
row.summary: Latitudes Nord, run by French polar guide Michael Charavin, holds two snowkite touring weeks - kiting on snow with skis, not on water - in Finse, the railway village at 1,222 m between the Hardangerjøkulen glacier and the Skarvheimen mountains in Norway. From an apartment in the village (with a cook) a group of 3 to 4 goes out every day on wind-powered tours over frozen lakes, valleys and summits, sometimes 20 to 40 km downwind with the train back; the first week is a discovery of snowkite touring for riders who can already kite on snow, the second a coaching week for intermediate riders. Price per the trip sheet: EUR 2,500 per person on a basis of 4 participants (+EUR 100 with 3), flights, train and any Oslo nights not included. Next dates: 6 February to 13 February 2027 (discovery week), 13 February to 20 February 2027 (advanced week); booking by request.

row.title: Kite Republic Aitutaki Winter Escape 2027
row.summary: Kite Republic's Aitutaki Winter Escape is a 13-night kiteboarding and wingfoiling holiday on Aitutaki in the Cook Islands, based at Ranganui's Retreat beachfront bungalows on the lagoon, for a group of at most 18. The 2027 dates are 2027-07-16 to 2027-07-29 and 2027-07-30 to 2027-08-12; riders of all levels and non-riding partners are welcome. The early-bird pay-in-full price is AUD 5,200 per person in a twin share (standard AUD 5,500), with a AUD 1,000 deposit; flights are extra.

row.title: KiteWest Wave & Freestyle Kite Camp Coronation Beach
row.summary: KiteWest and Shark Bay Kitesurfing run a 7-day wave and freestyle kite camp at Coronation Beach near Geraldton, Western Australia, for intermediate and advanced riders in groups of 4 to 10. row.title: ION CLUB Dakhla Oasis212 Lessons Package
row.summary: ION CLUB's opening packages at its centre inside the Oasis212 hotel on the Dakhla lagoon: 7 nights in a wooden chalet with partial lagoon view (double bed plus living room with 2 convertible beds, private terrace), full board and the round-trip transfer from Dakhla airport. The lessons package adds 6 hours of semi-private kitesurf or wing foil lessons for all levels (EUR 830 per person, double occupancy); the rental package adds 6 days of gear rental instead (EUR 780). Several spots - flat and choppy, shallow and deep water - lie right at the centre, with side to side-onshore wind around 20 knots. Valid for travel between 2026-10-05 and 2026-12-21, minimum 4 nights; booking on request.
